regions.today: A dull, damp and rather wet start this morning as a band of rain sinks further south. Brighter and much fresher conditions will follow however with a mix of sunshine and scattered showers along with a brisk westerly breeze. Highs of 13 to 15 degrees.
regions.tonight: A little breezy with a mix of clear spells and isolated showers but much of the east and south will remain dry. Lows of 8 to 10 degrees.
regions.tomorrow: Another breezy day with northwesterly winds persisting. Overall it will be a mix of sunshine and just isolated showers but with more dry weather following through into the evening. Highs of 12 to 15 degrees.
